--- import type { HTMLAttributes } from "astro/types" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Price, PriceUnit, PriceValue } from "@/components/ui/price" import { Section, SectionContainer, SectionTitle, } from "@/components/ui/section" import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator" type Props = HTMLAttributes<"section"> & { badge: string title: string products: { title: string description: string price: { value: number currency: string unit: string } }[] } const { class: className, badge, title, products, ...props } = Astro.props ---
{badge} {title}
{ products.map((item) => (

{item.title}

{item.description}

{item.price.unit}
)) }
